answers.plain:
**Subject: September Update: MRR $47.5k (+16%), 6 new enterprise pilots**

Hi all,

September was a solid month, with one miss on the mobile app.

**Numbers**
- MRR: $47.5k, up from $41k (+$6.5k, +16% MoM)
- Churn: 2.1%
- New enterprise pilots: 6

**Wins**
- Signed 6 enterprise pilots this month. Pilots aren't revenue yet, so our focus now is converting them to paid contracts.
- MRR growth of 16% came with churn holding at 2.1%.

**Miss**
- The mobile app slipped two weeks. [One line on the cause, e.g., scope creep, a dependency, or an underestimate.] The new ship date is [date]. [One line on what you're changing so it doesn't repeat.]

**Focus for October**
- Convert pilots to paid contracts
- Ship the mobile app by [date]
- [Third priority]

**Asks**
- **Intros to hospital networks.** We'd love introductions to decision-makers (CIO, CMIO, or innovation leads) at hospital systems or networks. If you know someone, reply with a short blurb and we'll write the forward-ready note.

Thanks as always,
[Name]

---

A few notes:
- I put in brackets the things I didn't know: the cause of the slip, the new date, and your October priorities. Candor works best if you name the actual cause.
- If you can share which verticals or sizes the 6 pilots are in, one line on that would make the hospital-network ask more credible.
- Add the 2.1% churn context if you have it (better or worse than August, and whether it's logo or revenue churn). Investors will ask.

If you give me those details, I can tighten it into a final version.

# Draft: September 2026 Investor Update

**Subject: [Company] September update: MRR $47.5k (+16%), 6 new enterprise pilots, mobile slipped 2 weeks**

Hi all,

September was a good month on growth and a miss on mobile. Details below.

**Headline numbers**

| | Aug | Sep | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| MRR | $41.0k | $47.5k | +$6.5k (+15.9%) |
| Monthly churn | n/a | 2.1% | [vs. Aug: __%] |
| Enterprise pilots signed | n/a | 6 | |

**What went well**
- **MRR grew 16% month over month.** [One line on the source: new logos, expansion, or both.]
- **We signed 6 enterprise pilots.** [Name the ones you can, or describe them, e.g. "2 health systems, 1 payer…". Add the pilot-to-paid conversion goal and timeline.]
- **Churn was 2.1%.** [One sentence on why. Was it concentrated in a few small accounts, or spread out? Is it in line with your target?]

**What didn't**
- **The mobile app slipped two weeks.** [Cause in one sentence.] [New ship date.] [What it delays, e.g. pilot rollouts. If nothing, say so.] [What you changed so it doesn't repeat.]

**Focus for October**
1. [Convert/onboard the 6 pilots. Define what success looks like.]
2. [Ship mobile by DATE.]
3. [Third priority.]

**Asks**
- **Introductions to hospital networks.** We're looking for intros to [CIO / CMIO / VP of Ops / innovation leads] at [target systems or regions, e.g. "multi-site systems with 5+ hospitals"]. If you know someone, reply with a name and I'll send a short forwardable blurb to make the intro easy.
- [Optional: any second ask, like hiring or a specific advisor.]

Thanks as always for the support. Reply with questions or pushback anytime.

[Name]

---

**Notes on the draft**
- **Churn:** I assumed 2.1% is monthly. If it's logo churn rather than revenue churn, say which. If it's revenue churn, that's about $860 of MRR lost, so gross new and expansion MRR was roughly $7.4k. That's a good number to include if it's accurate.
- **What investors will look for:**
  - Where the growth came from (new vs. expansion).
  - Runway and burn. Even one line ("runway: __ months") stops the "what's cash?" reply.
  - Pilot-to-paid conversion. Six pilots is only a lead indicator until some convert, so state your expected conversion and when you'll know.
- **The hospital ask:** The more specific it is (titles, health-system size, regions, named targets), the more likely someone can act on it. Offering a forwardable blurb makes it much easier for them to help.
- **Length:** It's short, as you asked. If you cut anything, cut the October section before the miss. Candor about the miss is what builds trust.

If you send me the bracketed details (pilot names, mobile cause and date, runway), I'll produce a final version.
